scientific_integrity: All infinite assertions are proved analytically; cited results are distinguished from the new empirical-spectrum classification. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Necessity assumes two fixed second-derivative points; no assertion of surjectivity, rates, or unique priority over unindexed sparse-block examples. Finite exact-rational checks supplement, but do not replace, proof.
title: Complete empirical-measure interval spectrum on a two-point rank-two compactum
